In these challenging times, it’s more important than ever to uplift mall businesses in your community. That’s why we’re proud to offer this pin celebrating the hardworking local arms dealers who form the backbone of neighborhood blahblahblah libtard nonsense.

Support independent, family-owned gun shops over big corporate retailers. These local entrepreneurs provide vital community services, create jobs, and help keep essential tools of self-determination accessible to people who hate paying for shipping.
